title: Priority Point System v1
summary: Adds prospective recommendation scoring and a durable owner-managed outreach queue while preserving the deployment wave's legacy workflow
changes: Protected the deployment-time wave and all weekly reviews on the unchanged legacy Send, Reject, Other and Recheck controls
Added a persistent five-tier recommendation menu for only newly created PPS waves
Implemented deterministic F plus G plus H scoring with current uploader CP and strict unknown-not-zero handling
Added a durable ranked outreach queue with component snapshots, evidence history and idempotent repair
Added owner-managed outreach cycles, private attempt records and confirmed moderator-submission tracking
Added supervised CP, level-status and fixed 30-day outcome maintenance in bounded provider-aware batches
Added private PPS dashboard, queue, level, cycle, outreach, refresh, override and evidence commands
Added schema-8 migration, recovery documentation and regression coverage for legacy rollout, formulas, cycles and restart durability
